Rajan Dudhale Pune, Maharashtra, India +91 9637828553 | rajandudhale78@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Operations Analyst with 5.8 years of experience in investment banking middle office, asset servicing, hedge fund operations, and reconciliation. Strong expertise in OTC products, cash and position reconciliation, corporate actions, and NAV support. Proven ability to investigate complex breaks, improve operational controls, and collaborate with global stakeholders in high-volume environments.

CORE SKILLS Reconciliation & Break Resolution | OTC Products (FX, Swaps) | Asset Servicing | Fund Operations | Corporate Actions | Cash & Position Reconciliation | NAV Support | Financial Reporting | Data Analysis | Excel | Bloomberg Terminal | Power BI | Stakeholder Collaboration | Operational Controls | Time Management

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

State Street Randstad Payroll) - Senior Operations Analys - Middle Office

Reconciliation



Performed end-to-end trade settlement for Equities, Fixed Income, and OTC products, ensuring timely settlement within market cut-offs.

Managed the trade lifecycle from trade validation and settlement instruction through reconciliation





•

and exception resolution. Executed trade processing, settlement monitoring, and cash & position reconciliation for institutional client portfolios. Investigated and resolved trade, cash, and position breaks through root cause analysis, ensuring timely resolution within SLA. Performed pre-settlement validation and verified trade details prior to settlement processing. Coordinated with Front Office, Middle Office, Custodians, Brokers, and Agent Banks to resolve settlement exceptions.

Barclays (Randstad Payroll) — Senior Operations Analyst, Middle Office

Reconciliation Aug 2025 – Feb 2026 | Contract



Investigated and resolved internal, nostro, and depot reconciliation breaks caused by data and feed discrepancies.

Managed OTC products including FX and rate swaps while performing Volcker exception clearing. • Delivered market cutoff transaction reporting to support front office threshold validation. • • Collaborated with global stakeholders to improve reconciliation workflows and operational controls. Supported end-to-end post-trade lifecycle for OTC products (FX & Rate Swaps), including transaction validation, reconciliation, settlement support, exception management, and operational controls. Performed end-to-end trade lifecycle support for OTC products from trade capture through settlement and reconciliation. Conducted trade enrichment and validation prior to downstream processing. Investigated STP exceptions, settlement failures, and unmatched trades through root cause analysis. Collaborated with Front Office, Operations, and Technology teams to resolve trade and settlement issues within SLA. Performed pre-settlement validation to ensure trade completeness before market cut-offs.



• •

•

BNY (Russell Tobin Payroll) — Senior Operations Analyst, Mutual Fund Servicing

Jun 2024 – Jun 2025



Processed accounting entries including paydowns, coupons, repo and STIF trades, and position reconciliations. Investigated and resolved corporate action breaks including dividends, interest, splits, and mergers. Cleared aged cash, position, and transaction reconciliation items while reporting to onshore teams.

• • Delivered final reconciliation confirmations supporting NAV valuation processes. •

Supported Fund Administration activities including trade processing, pricing validation, and NAV support. Performed daily trade processing for Repo, STIF, coupons, paydowns, and corporate action events. Executed cash, position, and transaction reconciliations ensuring accurate fund accounting records. Investigated reconciliation breaks and completed timely exception resolution before NAV release

• •

Northern Trust — Senior Operations Analyst, Alternative Asset Servicing Oct

2022 – Oct 2023

Reconciled custodian records with accounting data for alternative investment assets. • • • • Assisted in trade settlement monitoring and exception management. • Supported valuation and NAV reporting activities for alternative investment funds.

Processed administrator data ensuring accurate accounting for distributions and non-cash trades. Supported trade processing for alternative investment portfolios. Performed cash and position reconciliations between accounting and custodian records.

Managed over 300 alternative assets and high-volume accounting entries monthly.

Coordinated with internal teams, auditors, and clients to maintain reporting accuracy.

CITCO — Senior Operations Analyst, Hedge Fund Services Nov 2021 – Aug 2022

Investigated cash, position, and transaction reconciliation breaks using TLM and Aexeo LENS systems.

Supported portfolio risk reporting and NAV sign-off processes.

Assisted onboarding and migration of hedge fund client portfolios.

Performed daily cash, position, and trade reconciliations for hedge fund portfolios.

Supported Fund Accounting and NAV sign-off activities through reconciliation and break resolution.

Investigated trade processing differences, failed trades, and settlement exceptions.

Worked closely with Prime Brokers and Custodians to resolve outstanding reconciliation breaks.

Performed portfolio-level reconciliation across multiple asset classes.

State Street HCL — Senior Analyst, Derivative ETD Operations Aug 2019 – Oct

2021

Processed listed derivatives trade instructions and broker reconciliations.

Reconciled fund cash, trade transactions, and position balances with broker statements.

Supported new fund setup and asset identification processes.

Reviewed investment manager instructions across ETD processing platforms.

Processed trade instructions and monitored trade settlements for Listed Derivatives.

Performed trade validation and broker confirmation checks before settlement.

Investigated trade breaks and settlement exceptions ensuring timely resolution.

Supported new fund onboarding, security setup, and asset master maintenance.

EDUCATION

Master of Business Administration (Finance & Accounting) Solapur University — 2019

Bachelor of Engineering (E&TC;) Pune University — 2015

TOOLS & SYSTEMS

TLM | Aexeo LENS | MCH | ETD Swift Systems | TLS | MTEX | Blotter Platforms
